title: 2D contact process DP critical exponents (finite-size scaling)
script_content:
import numpy as np, json
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def run(L,b,runs,steps,a=0.5,seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    rhos=[]; taus=[]
    for r in range(runs):
        s=(rng.random((L,L))<0.3).astype(np.float64)
        tlast=0
        for t in range(steps):
            nbr=np.roll(s,1,0)+np.roll(s,-1,0)+np.roll(s,1,1)+np.roll(s,-1,1)
            rs=rng.random((L,L)); rb=rng.random((L,L))
            s=np.where(s==1, rs<a, rb<(b*nbr))
            if s.mean()>1e-5: tlast=t+1
        rhos.append(s.mean())
        taus.append(tlast)
    return np.array(rhos), np.array(taus)

bc=0.2375
sizes=[64,128,192,256]
rows=[]
for L in sizes:
    rho,tau=run(L,bc,runs=120,steps=300,seed=L)
    mrho=rho.mean(); mtau=tau.mean()
    rows.append((L,mrho,mtau))
    print('L',L,'rho',round(mrho,4),'tau',round(mtau,1))
Ls=np.array([r[0] for r in rows]); Rh=np.array([r[1] for r in rows]); Tp=np.array([r[2] for r in rows])
slope_rho=np.polyfit(np.log(Ls),np.log(Rh),1)[0]
slope_tau=np.polyfit(np.log(Ls),np.log(Tp),1)[0]
nu_lit=0.733; beta_lit=0.583; z_lit=1.131
beta_est=slope_rho*(-nu_lit)
print('slope_rho',round(slope_rho,3),'beta_est',round(beta_est,3),'slope_tau(z)',round(slope_tau,3))

bs=np.linspace(0.18,0.30,25); Us=[]; Rhb=[]
for b in bs:
    rho,_=run(160,b,runs=30,steps=250,seed=int(b*1000)%100000)
    m=rho*160*160
    U=(m**2).mean()/(m.mean()**2) if m.mean()>1e-12 else float('nan')
    Us.append(U); Rhb.append(rho.mean())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9))
ax[0,0].loglog(Ls,Rh,'o-'); ax[0,0].set_title('rho vs L at b_c (slope=%.2f=-beta/nu)'%slope_rho); ax[0,0].set_xlabel('L'); ax[0,0].set_ylabel('mean rho')
ax[0,1].loglog(Ls,Tp,'s-'); ax[0,1].set_title('tau vs L at b_c (z=%.2f)'%slope_tau); ax[0,1].set_xlabel('L'); ax[0,1].set_ylabel('mean tau')
ax[1,0].plot(bs,Rhb,'-'); ax[1,0].axvline(bc,ls='--',color='r'); ax[1,0].set_title('rho(b) at L=160'); ax[1,0].set_xlabel('b'); ax[1,0].set_ylabel('mean rho')
ax[1,1].plot(bs,Us,'-'); ax[1,1].axvline(bc,ls='--',color='r'); ax[1,1].set_title('moment ratio U(b) at L=160'); ax[1,1].set_xlabel('b'); ax[1,1].set_ylabel('U')
fig.suptitle('2D contact process: DP critical exponents (lit beta=%.2f nu=%.2f z=%.2f)'%(beta_lit,nu_lit,z_lit))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('loom_dp_exponents.png',dpi=100)
json.dump({'b_c':bc,'slope_rho':slope_rho,'beta_est':beta_est,'slope_tau(z)':slope_tau,'lit':{'beta':beta_lit,'nu':nu_lit,'z':z_lit},'sizes':Ls.tolist(),'rho':Rh.tolist(),'tau':Tp.tolist()},open('loom_dp_metrics.json','w'),indent=2)
print('DONE')
